preconditions.name: a1b1_modulatory_channel_route_range_supra_floor
preconditions.description: ARM_A1B1 IN-ARM RAW cross-candidate RANGE of the modulatory bias routed into the E3 selection authority (modulatory_channel_route_range, read LIVE at the select tick) clears the floor: the divergent channel REACHES the bias the conflict-graded shortlist arbitrates. SAME range statistic the route-range substrate gates on. Below floor => routing not wired / e2 under-trained => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: ARM_A1B1: candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward (genuinely action-divergent), route-range routing + top-k shortlist ON

preconditions.name: a1b1_e2_world_forward_prediction_spread_supra_floor
preconditions.description: ARM_A1B1 e2.world_forward(z0, a_i) per-candidate prediction spread (cand_world_pairwise_dist) clears the floor -- SD-056 trained the action-conditional divergence the eligible set needs. RANGE statistic. Below floor => SD-056 under-trained => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.name: a1b1_grading_quantities_and_gap_distribution_non_vacuous
preconditions.description: ARM_A1B1 conflict-graded k_effective varies across P1 ticks (spread >= 1), the gap-scaled commit T_eff varies (spread > eps), AND the per-tick F-gap spans >= gap_min_populated_bins gap bins. A flat k / flat T_eff / single-gap distribution (monostrategy-pinned gap) means the grading could not act -> the test is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a verdict label. Count statistic (seeds meeting all three).
preconditions.control: ARM_A1B1: both MECH-439 levers ON; k_effective_spread / t_eff_spread / n_populated_gap_bins read live

routing.conversion_ceiling_persists_despite_conf: OFF-RAMP -> the V4 directions in conversion_ceiling_phase0_synthesis (divisive normalization / output-null subspace / cross-tick QD archive); NOT a falsification of MECH-439
